discription: A percussive, plucked string-like sound using the Karplus-Strong algorithm, controlled by a quick envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, decayTime=0.5, brightness=0.5; var sig, env; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.linen(0.001, decayTime, 0.01, curve: \lin), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = WhiteNoise.ar(amp * env); sig = CombN.ar(sig, 1 / freq, 1 / freq, decayTime * (1 + brightness)); sig = sig * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
